content: Dǝl ˈYimi Nǝ Pi
Kǝ waladi kǝ canǝ ɗa dǝl nǝ ˈyimi nǝ pi, kǝra wu mbǝl wilwilu ǝnggǝr doragalǝu, kǝra a vǝr huhwi sara dar tsǝkafǝ nǝ Hyal ǝnga nǝ Zǝr Gamǝ

a gyar hada lagu nǝ hada mǝlmau. Wu nǝ pi kau, dadakǝ ngǝ nggilanga ja ar ghimbila dǝl kau. Wu kau, wu ya yayar wu kumo apǝ mǝthlǝ wu fa, ju ya wazha kalar hya. Hyali wu kau kundzǝgǝ ngau aga shilǝgǝ ˈyiˈyi pampamǝu.
Tsu shiˈwu nǝ Hyal wu ɓǝra ɗa wu mǝlmǝ kǝ mai. Tsǝkafǝ nǝ Hyal ǝnga nǝ Zǝr Gamǝ wu nda ɗa wu mǝlmǝ kau. Njir mǝl thlǝr nyi wu nda dlǝvǝ nyi.
Ndu nda lari bama ja. Thlǝmǝ nyi tsu wu nda ɗa tsǝtsǝfǝ ar huɗǝma nda.
Tsu vuˈyi wu nda ɗa mai. Tsu nju ɓǝra nda yiwu vanyi mbǝmbǝl pitǝlla alaga mbǝl pǝci kǝra wu shili ǝnga mbǝmbǝl mai, arya Hyal ǝnga kǝrnyi ngu nda ɗa mbǝmbǝl anǝ nda. Ndu nda sǝm tǝlkur baˈanuwa.

Kǝ waladi kǝ nar ɗa, “Ndǝr kau, ndǝr kǝra ndu sǝn fǝr kǝr ǝni ngau ǝnga ndǝr jiri ngau. Hyal Thlagǝu, thlagǝr mambǝlˈyar nǝ nabiˈyar, ngǝ sǝwa waladi nyi aga ja cabiya anǝ njir mǝl thlǝr nyi sǝra wu nda ɗa kajangǝkau.”
Yesu A vǝr Shida
“Nggara mau, kǝja ya vǝr shida kajangǝkau! Barka anǝ ndǝra ɓǝlari ndǝrhaha kau, kǝra wu lǝkakaɗǝ kau.”
Nayi Yahwana, Nayi ngǝ nggari ǝnga lari sǝˈyar kau. Ama ta yi lari, kǝ yi nggari, kǝ yi ɓǝliya undi aga ya dlǝvǝ waladi kǝra canǝ ɗa sǝˈyar kau.
Ama kǝ ji nar ɗa, “Ga sara mǝl abangǝ mai! Nayi ndǝr mǝl thlǝr kuvwar hyi ngau, nagǝ ǝnga zamǝ ngǝˈyar nabiˈyar ǝnga kalar njira ɓǝlari ndǝr lǝkakaɗǝ kau. Ga dlǝvǝ Hyal!”
Kǝ ji nar ɗa, “Ga sara ghiɗǝna ndǝr nǝ ndǝrhaha nǝ lǝkakaɗǝ kǝ mai, arya pǝci a ɗari lǝhǝu.

Taˈyi njir mǝl sǝ ɗǝmwaˈyu nda dumwa ǝnga mǝl sǝ ɗǝmwaˈyir nda, njir mǝl sǝ gǝra tsatsaˈa tsu nda dumwa ǝnga mǝl sǝra gǝra tsatsaˈa, njir mǝl sǝ tsapǝu nda dumwa ǝnga mǝl sǝra tsapǝu, nji cicau nda dumwa ǝnga mǝl sǝra cicau.”
“Nggara mau, kǝja ya vǝr shili kajangǝkau! Akkǝri ɗa aˈyi ǝnga yau, ba ya nda nǝ nyi anǝ kalar ndǝ tsaˈa aga sǝr mǝla ja.
Nayi ngǝ Alǝfa ǝnga Omega, Tanggǝrma ǝnga Jomǝ ndǝl, Dzǝguya ǝnga Kuɗiya.
“Barka anǝ njira cina kar har nda aga nda uya lagur sǝm Wu Nǝ Pi, ba nda gwu huɗa mǝlmǝ lagu miyar gwa.
Abiya ngǝ hyaˈyar ǝnga njir pipitima ǝnga nji sǝsu ǝnga njir tsa ndau ǝnga njir nu katǝu ba ǝnga kalar njir yiwu fati ǝnga mǝl thlǝr fati.
“Nayi Yesu, a sǝwari yi waladi ɗa aga ja nǝ ngǝ sakida kau aga ga nǝ nyi anǝ daɓǝr njir nu. Nayi ngǝ culi ǝnga nggyilanga Dawuda ǝnga nayi ngǝ shashilga vǝlang.”

Mambǝl ǝnga kwanjili kǝ na, “Shila mau!” Kalar ndǝra nggar ɗa, taˈyi ja na, “Shila mau!” Kalar ndǝra ǝnga hili, taˈyi ja shili ǝnga kalar ndǝra wu yiwu aga ja uya ˈyimi nǝ pi, bǝgǝ ja dlǝwuri kurthlǝu.
Yu tǝɗǝ himiya kalar ndǝra wu nggar ndǝr nǝ lǝkakaɗǝ ndǝrhaha kau, ma ndǝra cakǝri a dagǝri, Hyal wu nda cakǝr nyi ɓwaɓwatǝ kǝra Hyal nana wu lǝkakaɗǝ nyi kau.
Ma ndǝra gǝnna ndǝr sara wu lǝkakaɗǝ nǝ ndǝrhaha kau, Hyal wu nda hǝbiya nǝ nya nubwa nǝ mǝsahǝkur sara wu wu nǝ pi ǝnga sara wu mǝlmǝ cici nǝ Hyal, ǝnggǝr kǝra nji tsǝfǝri wu lǝkakaɗǝ kau.
Ndǝra lǝr sakida sǝˈyar kǝ na, “Angǝ, ya vǝr shili kajangǝkau.” Amina, Shili, Thlagǝ Yesu.
Taˈyi mayiwakur nǝ Thlagǝ Yesu a nggya ǝkkǝˈyi nji cici gǝ Hyal patǝu. Amina.
